summary.zh: 拆解季度 OKR，定产品愿景与路线图
summary.en: Cascade quarterly OKRs and shape vision and roadmap

description.zh: 把公司级目标拆成季度 OKR 并落到团队，同时起草产品愿景、路线图和团队结构。适合季度规划，以及需要让多个团队对齐方向时使用。
description.en: Cascades company goals into quarterly OKRs by team, and drafts product vision, roadmap and team structure. Use it for quarterly planning or when several teams need to align on direction.
